title: Damage, then heal
prompt: Using the starter's members and helpers: the robot takes 40 damage, then heals 15, and damage_then_heal reports the health left. From 100 that is 75.
hints: take_damage, then heal, then return health; each helper changes the same variable at the top of the script (a member variable) in turn.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A member variable: every function in the script can read and change it.
